source: Live probe: an isolated gateway on its own port, a forced tier, real Anthropic API calls with each effort level. A model that rejects effort answers 400 "This model does not support the effort parameter". Sonnet 5.5: Claude Code 2.1.286 `claude -p` through the gateway forced to low, one call per level, all 200 (2026-10-01). Haiku 5.5: documented, not live-probed; output_config.effort accepts low, medium, high, xhigh, max (model-cards anthropic-claude-haiku-5-5, 2026-10-08).
